rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns a refusal to take enforcement action regarding an alleged breach of conditions attached to a water permit (watervergunning). Enforcement of watervergunning conditions falls squarely within water governance and the regulatory_permit category, without involving household water/sanitation connection refusal or informal settlements.
